DECISION D37 - FROZEN N1C METHOD

Input and outcome
N1C consumes the accepted N1B OOS population without changing its issuer-local TRAIN ECDF news measurement or TRAIN-scaled future h5 path-volatility outcome.

Controls
The prior-volatility control is the backward five-session path ending on the decision session, divided by the issuer-fold TRAIN median. Dollar-volume surprise is log of current adjusted close times volume divided by the median of exactly the prior 60 sessions; the current session is excluded from that baseline.

Statistic
Within each OOS quarter, rank news, outcome, and both controls. Residualize the news and outcome ranks against both control ranks, then correlate the residuals. This is evaluation, not model fitting.

DECISION D37 - PRIMARY NONREDUNDANCY EVIDENCE

Evidence
Mean raw fold Spearman is 0.1073. Mean conditional fold Spearman is 0.0878, an average attenuation of 0.0195. Conditional correlation is positive in all 12 OOS quarters versus the frozen requirement of at least 8.

Meaning
The two OHLCV controls explain part of the association, as expected, but do not remove its cross-quarter ordering. The magnitude remains modest; stability is the main evidence.

Boundary
Overlapping h5 outcomes make naive row-level significance tests inappropriate. No causal, directional, or trading claim follows.

DECISION D37 - WHAT THE CONTROLS ABSORB

Evidence
News intensity is positively associated with prior volatility and especially with same-day dollar-volume surprise in every quarter. Prior volatility also orders future volatility in most quarters. These are genuine redundancy channels.

Meaning
Conditioning is necessary: raw news counts partly reflect turbulence and attention already visible in the tape. The surviving partial relationship is therefore more informative than the raw relationship alone.

Causal boundary
Same-day volume may partly mediate the same event as news. That is acceptable here because the question is incremental system information, not causal attribution.

All 11 population, timing, TRAIN-support, and leakage checks pass. Every N1B OOS row has both controls. Raw N1B fold correlations reproduce with maximum absolute difference 4.44e-16. There are zero issuer-fold control-support failures.

Decision
All three frozen N1C gates pass. News intensity retains stable incremental uncertainty ordering beyond recent path volatility and current dollar-volume surprise.
